headline: What “il” learned
text: At the start, “il” was only a list of numbers, the same in every sentence. It asked a question, compared its query with the keys of every word, turned the scores into a recipe, then blended the values. By the end, “il” points to the animal when the sentence ends in “tired”, and to the boulevard when it ends in “wide”: its meaning comes from the other words.
summary: A question, keys, scores, a recipe, a blend: that is the story of <ch7>chapters 7 to 10</ch7>.
